definition: to arrange for a table to be kept for you
exampleSentence: We reserved a table by the window.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đặt một bàn cạnh cửa sổ.

definition: to tell the waiter you want a table
exampleSentence: We asked for a table for two.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi xin một bàn cho hai người.

definition: to read the list of food and drinks
exampleSentence: Let's look at the menu.
exampleTranslation: Mình cùng xem thực đơn nhé.

definition: to tell the waiter what food you want
exampleSentence: We ordered food and waited.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi gọi món rồi ngồi chờ.

definition: to tell the waiter which drink you want
exampleSentence: I'll order a drink first.
exampleTranslation: Tôi gọi đồ uống trước.

definition: to write down what a customer wants to eat or drink
exampleSentence: May I take your order?
exampleTranslation: Tôi ghi món cho quý khách nhé?

definition: to say which food is good to order
exampleSentence: Can you recommend a dish?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể giới thiệu một món không?

definition: to tell the waiter you want to pay
translation: xin hóa đơn, gọi tính tiền
exampleSentence: We asked for the bill and left.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi gọi tính tiền rồi ra về.

definition: to ask the waiter to come to your table
exampleSentence: Let's call the waiter.
exampleTranslation: Mình gọi nhân viên phục vụ đi.

definition: to wait until your meal is brought
exampleSentence: We waited for the food for twenty minutes.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi chờ món ăn hai mươi phút.

definition: to return food to the kitchen because it is wrong
exampleSentence: He sent the soup back because it was cold.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy trả lại món súp vì nó nguội.

definition: to buy cooked food to eat at home
exampleSentence: Let's get a takeaway tonight.
exampleTranslation: Tối nay mình mua đồ ăn mang về nhé.

definition: to eat one dish together with other people
exampleSentence: We shared a dish of noodles.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi chia nhau một đĩa mì.

definition: to eat a food for the first time
exampleSentence: I'd like to try a local dish.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn thử một món địa phương.

definition: to clean your mouth with a napkin
exampleSentence: He wiped his mouth with a napkin.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy lau miệng bằng khăn giấy.

definition: to wipe your hands or mouth with a napkin
exampleSentence: Use a napkin, please.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng khăn ăn nhé.

definition: to eat with two thin sticks
exampleSentence: Can you use chopsticks?
exampleTranslation: Bạn dùng đũa được không?

definition: to eat with a knife in one hand and a fork in the other
exampleSentence: We use a knife and fork to eat steak.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi dùng dao và nĩa để ăn bít tết.

definition: to say a word before drinking together
exampleSentence: We raised our glasses and said cheers.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi nâng ly và cùng chúc nhau.

definition: to lift your glass to wish someone well
exampleSentence: Let's raise a glass to the bride and groom.
exampleTranslation: Nâng ly chúc mừng cô dâu chú rể nào.

definition: to eat all the food on your plate
exampleSentence: Finish your plate before you leave the table.
exampleTranslation: Ăn hết đĩa rồi mới rời khỏi bàn.
